neutral_facts.fact: the child can be claimed as a dependent on the parents' joint return, whose taxable income is $150,000
neutral_facts.reason: the example gives no parent facts; Form 8615 line 1 and 2 do not depend on them

neutral_facts.fact: the child has no other income and no itemized deductions; the Form 1099-INT payer is an unrelated bank
neutral_facts.reason: the example gives the child's unearned income only

neutral_facts.fact: the child's $300 of directly connected itemized deductions is left out
neutral_facts.reason: the instruction's own Caution suspends miscellaneous itemized deductions; line 2 is $2,700 either way because it exceeds $1,350 + $300
